title: [Decision] Official connector-app listing identity before the first publish: `app.objectstack.connector-<vendor>` as the package id, `<vendor>` as the namespace, `@objectstack/connector-app-<vendor>` as the private npm name
body:
epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Ruled: 6545945833 · letter A + partner reverse-domain · 2026-10-31T16:19Z
Ruling-ref: 6545945833

Filing gate: ② a decision only the maintainer takes — a public identifier that can never change once published. Raised by the #28276 dev (`open_questions[1]`, PR #28306). Child of #27293 (E4). ⛔ Not a claim. Nothing is published until the cloud pipeline (#28278) runs, so this card blocks no merge; it must be ruled before the first `os package publish`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：不改代码。首个官方连接器应用（GitHub，PR #28306）上架前，要定下官方连接器应用的「身份」命名规则：包 id、命名空间、npm 包名。
- 为什么改：包 id（`manifestId`）一旦发布就永远不能改（上架手册：`content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx:34`「reverse-domain, immutable once published」），每个后续官方连接器都会照这个规则起名；这是对外的品牌与标识，席位不代定。
- 风险与回滚：发布之前改名零成本；发布之后改不了。
- 先看：下面「选项」表。
- 两分钟验证：看 PR #28306 里 `packages/apps/connector-github/objectstack.manifest.json` 与 `package.json` 的前几行。
- 需要你做的：选 A 或 B（B 请直接写出规则）。

## Options

| | Package id | Namespace | npm name (private) | Basis |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | `app.objectstack.connector-<vendor>` (e.g. `app.objectstack.connector-github`) | `<vendor>` (`github`) | `@objectstack/connector-app-<vendor>` | follows the one official listing (`app.objectstack.hotcrm`); `@objectstack/connector-*` already names the executor packages (`connector-mcp`, `connector-openapi`), so the app takes `connector-app-` |
| **B** | another rule you name | | | |

## 四维分析

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性：20–30 个官方连接器会沿用同一规则；A 与已有官方应用 `app.objectstack.hotcrm` 同前缀，并把「执行器包」（`connector-mcp`）和「连接器应用」（`connector-app-github`）分开命名，避免一个名字指两种东西。
- ② 实际业务拉动：首个应用已写好，等的就是这条规则；发布前改名零成本。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错：规则写死在一处，写下一个应用的 agent 照抄即可；A 的 npm 名与执行器包不冲突，agent 不会把应用当执行器依赖。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散：两选项都不加代码或门禁。
Prior rulings read: manifestId, listing id, package id, namespace → handbook `:34` (immutable once published); no ruling on official-app naming; thread: #28276 report; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## Recommendation

**A**, because it matches the one existing official listing and keeps the executor and app names apart. Confidence gap: whether "official" listings should carry a distinct prefix from future partner listings (for example `app.objectstack.` vs `app.<partner>.`) is a marketplace policy this repository does not record.

Self-check: 只看①选 A；②③④ 是否翻转：否。

## After the ruling

- A: PR #28306 lands as is; every later connector app follows the rule; the handbook's listing section gains one line naming it.
- B: the epic PM rewrites the three identifiers on PR #28306 before it lands (nothing is published yet).
